title: From ideas to a shared plan

blocks.title: Arrive and align
blocks.notes: Welcome everyone. Explain the decision we need to make and the ending time.

blocks.title: Frame the challenge
blocks.notes: Share the fictional project brief. Clarify the problem before suggesting solutions.

blocks.title: Explore possibilities
blocks.notes: Write ideas silently, then discuss in pairs. If shortened, collect one idea per person.

blocks.title: Take a breath
blocks.notes: Offer a quiet pause. Adjust for participants’ access needs before shortening the break.

blocks.title: Choose the next experiment
blocks.notes: Compare options against the goal. Agree on one small experiment.

blocks.title: Commit and close
blocks.notes: Record an owner, a next step and a date. Give each person space for a final reflection.
